# The grid header-menu arrow is invisible when an app restyles its headers

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3).

## Context

Welcome! This is a small styling fix in Neo.mjs's grid. You need a fork, Node and the dev server (`npm run server-start`, then rebuild the themes after an SCSS change); no Agent OS, Docker or AI tooling.

Found in 13.3 release testing, 2026-10-20, in `examples/grid/issues` with headless Chrome. A column's header-menu arrow (`.neo-grid-menu-trigger`) should show on hover, and stay shown while the column is filtered. In this showcase it cannot be seen:

- neo-light: the arrow's text is white (`rgb(255, 255, 255)`) on a near-white header (`rgb(250, 249, 253)`).
- neo-dark: the arrow is black on a near-black header (`rgb(33, 30, 43)`).

The default grid headers in `examples/grid/bigData` are fine, because their header is blue or dark with light text.

## The Problem

The arrow is a button whose glyph is button text, coloured by `--button-text-color`. The grid header's own glyphs, its sort icons, use `--grid-header-button-glyph-color`. An app that restyles its headers through the grid header tokens therefore gets matching sort icons but a mismatched menu arrow.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/scss/src/grid/header/plugin/Menu.scss`: `.neo-grid-menu-trigger` sets `background: transparent` and no colour.
- `resources/scss/src/grid/header/Button.scss`: the header's `.neo-button-glyph` uses `var(--grid-header-button-glyph-color)`, and `-hover` on hover.
- `resources/scss/src/examples/grid/issues/MainContainer.scss` sets `--grid-header-button-glyph-color` to its muted colour, which the arrow never reads.

## The Fix

In `Menu.scss`, point the trigger's button-text tokens (`--button-text-color`, and its hover and active variants) at the grid header glyph tokens. The arrow then follows whatever the header's own icons use.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: in `examples/grid/issues`, in neo-light and neo-dark, the hovered arrow and a filtered column's arrow use the header glyph colour (`--grid-header-button-glyph-color`) and are visible.
- [ ] AC-2: in `examples/grid/bigData`, the arrow still matches its header.

## Out of Scope

- Header filter fields (`showHeaderFilters`) covering narrow captions, which is noted separately.

## Related

- The 13.3 header-menu chapter (#19712), `resources/scss/src/grid/header/Button.scss`.
